message.content:
The value of $20 in British Pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2024), 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP. Using that approximation:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \text{ GBP/USD} \approx £15.60
\]

So, roughly, $20 is about £15.60.  

**Note:** Exchange rates change constantly, so for an exact conversion you’d want to check a reliable financial source or a currency‑conversion tool at the time of your transaction.
